items.label: BASIC TOOL KIT
items.value: This is an essential tool set for daily home project and maintenance like furniture assembly, picture hanging and general purpose repairs etc.

items.label: EASY ORGANIZATION
items.value: Comes with a plastic toolbox storage case to keep all your tools organized and securely stored.

items.label: TOOLS LIST
items.value: (1) Claw hammer, (20) Screwdriver bits, (1) Bit driver, (1) Bit holder/extension (8) Hex keys, (4) Precision screwdrivers, (1) Slip joint pliers, (1) Tape measure, (1) Utility knife, (1) Scissor, (1) Storage box

items.label: DURABLE& RELIABLE
items.value: Heat treated and chrome plated to resist corrosion, meet ANSI quality standard and backed up by lifetime warranty.

items.label: GREAT GIFT IDEA
items.value: The pink tool set makes for a great gift idea for the DIY amateur or the avid handyman.
